summary.text: Justin Schumacher is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Republican Joy Goeben and Green Party candidate David Schupbach.
According to his campaign website, he is Parks Director for Outagamie County and Town Chair of the Town of Freedom.

paragraphs.text: Schumacher's campaign website says he is a lifelong Wisconsin resident and an Eagle Scout who worked on local farms and has experience in construction and the skilled trades.
It says he holds a Master of Public Administration from the University of Wisconsin–Green Bay.
It says he has built his career in local-government public service, including managing multimillion-dollar projects as county parks director.

On the website, Schumacher lists his priorities as keeping state-generated money in local communities first, housing affordability, and making farming financially and ecologically sustainable, including through seed reuse and right-to-repair for agricultural equipment.
